title: Review: jmap-mail-server pass 8
notes:
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: edge cases in EmailSubmission create validation (ForbiddenFrom delegated to backend by design). Uncertainty driven by: no SMTP-layer or identity policy tests. Would raise confidence with integration tests against a real backend.
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — two P0 correctness bugs exist (noRecipients, role-uniqueness cross-loop); both are protocol spec violations that external clients could trigger.
Idiom rating: CLEAN — no unsafe, error handling correct, ownership patterns appropriate. Iterators used properly.
Rust idiom confidence: 5% chance of missed issue. Least confident flags: none remaining. Uncertainty driven by: generic MailBackend trait could have subtle associated-type bound issues not visible in the handler layer.
